references.text: Similar to John 8:30 in describing a group that believes in Jesus but still does not confess it publicly for fear of the religious leaders.
Describes a similar reaction where many who saw Jesus' signs believed in him, just like those who heard him speak in John 8:30.
Refers to a similar situation in Jerusalem where many believed in his name when they saw the signs he performed, parallel to the faith in John 8:30.
Defines the consequence of believing in his name, which is the central theme in John 8:30 where many believe in him.
Linked to the theme of believing in him to receive eternal life, which is the core of the faith mentioned in John 8:30.
